title: Red car with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- car body -->
  <rect x='8' y='42' width='84' height='30' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#e83030'/>
  <!-- lighter roof/cabin -->
  <path d='M28 42 L34 26 Q36 22 42 22 L62 22 Q68 22 70 26 L76 42 Z' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <path d='M36 41 L40 28 Q41 26 44 26 L48 26 L48 41 Z' fill='#8fd8ff'/>
  <path d='M52 41 L52 26 L58 26 Q61 26 62 28 L66 41 Z' fill='#8fd8ff'/>
  <!-- windshield shine -->
  <path d='M38 38 L41 29 L43 29 L41 38 Z' fill='#d8f4ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- headlights -->
  <rect x='10' y='48' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#fff4a0'/>
  <rect x='82' y='48' width='8' height='8' rx='3' fill='#fff4a0'/>
  <!-- bumper highlights -->
  <rect x='14' y='60' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb0b0'/>
  <rect x='74' y='60' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb0b0'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='11' fill='#4a3a8a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='6' fill='#b0a0e0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='11' fill='#4a3a8a'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='6' fill='#b0a0e0'/>
  <!-- smiling face on body -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#4a3a8a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#4a3a8a'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ff9aa0'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ff9aa0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 58 Q50 66 58 58' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
